name: Battlemage
description: Battlemages learn magic as a tool for warfare rather than as an art or a craft, and they build up their body as well as their mind so that they are able to fight with weapons as well as with magic. The difficulty of maintaining this dual speciality means that battlemages require more experience to increase in level than any other class.

name: Cleric
description: Clerics are people who have devoted themselves to religious service. In exchange for taking vows to uphold their religion's principles and tenets and to never use bladed weapons, clerics gain the ability to drive away or even destroy undead creatures; and to cast clerical spells.

name: Druid
description: Druids nature worshippers. In exchange for their protection of nature, they gain the ability to cast spells and the ability to control animals. Druidic society has no hierarchy or structure and each druid is effectively their own master, doing as they think right, and druids take on individual initiates to whom they pass on the craft.

name: Fighter
description: Fighters are characters who have been trained in the art of combat from an early age. They range from noble chevaliers and daring swashbucklers to brutal thugs and grizzled mercenaries. In an adventuring party, fighters form the main front line, holding off the enemy and protecting the more vulnerable party members.

name: Grenadier
description: Grenadiers are experts in the use of red powder and its many applications as an explosive or propellant. They are able to refine the powder into a more potent form and use it in the creation of a variety of weapons and tools. description: Mountebanks are characters who dabble in many areas rather than concentrating in one. They can fight a bit, and sneak a bit, and cast a bit of magic. They tend to be charismatic social butterflies, who bluff their way through life and who rely on their wits to survive rather than any particular ability. name: Ranger
description: Rangers are wilderness and urban trackers and hunters, able to fight, but primarily focused on stealth and ranged attacks. Although they may spend much of their time in the wilderness, rangers do not have any special affinity with nature. While a minority of individual rangers follow druidic teachings, this is not a requirement. Many rangers, particularly those

name: Thief
description: Thieves are characters who specialise in subterfuge and trickery. They come from all social classes, from bored nobles seeking excitement to well trained and subtle assassins to former street urchins. Although the class is called "thief", thief characters are not always dishonest and do not always steal. Many of them use their talents for good rather than for personal benefit, and work as scouts and adventurers.

name: Wizard
description:
Wizards are characters who have studied the arcane arts and who are able to learn and cast magical spells.

Prospective wizards must study for years before they are able to master spell casting. In some larger cities such studying is done in a university, but in more rural areas with fewer resources and fewer people it is more likely to be a master/ apprentice system.
